title: Inside the long, bitter fight over one man’s quest to build the biggest AI datacenter in California
hook_text: Sebastian Rucci's massive California AI datacenter
script:
Sebastian Rucci wants to build the biggest AI datacenter in California.
His ambitious quest has triggered a long and bitter local fight.
The Guardian details the fierce opposition surrounding the massive facility.
These huge facilities demand immense power and water resources to operate.
Nearby Imperial County residents worry about severe grid strain.
Would you want a massive datacenter built in your town?
